title.narrative: Platform for local and national actors (L/NAs) in Ukraine

description.narrative:
CAFOD are co-funding a project which was originally submitted to DEC as a collective initiative under the Ukraine Humanitarian Appeal (UHA). Christian Aid will be project manager, with CAFOD, CARE and Save the Children contributing similar amounts of funding and coordinating closely to support the project.
Philanthropy in Ukraine (PhilinUA) is a new platform addressing the need for increased visibility of local and national actors (L/NAs) in Ukraine. It aims to effectively connect verified organisations with each other and donors, promote transparency and trust, and foster collaboration and knowledge-sharing within the charitable and philanthropic community. Philanthropy in Ukraine is a newly registered NGO in Ukraine and has completed Christian Aid's due diligence process to become a partner. The total budget for the project is £198,987. CAFOD will contribute £49,999.
In April 2024, DEC confirmed an additional 50% funding to top up the collective funding which covered £50,000 of the total project budget covered by the consortium (CAFOD, CARE, Christian Aid, Save the Children); see updated budget in 'Supporting Documents'. CAFOD's contribution will now cover 12.5% of the total project budget. Reporting for the full project will be received. Project Outcome Matrix updated to include outcomes, outputs and indicators as per Output Table submitted to DEC by Christian Aid.
